description: This file defines a BOMUpdateTool class for managing Bill of Materials updates, including methods for replacing BOMs, validating BOMs, updating BOM items, and retrieving parent BOMs. It also includes functions for enqueueing BOM replacement and cost updates, as well as updating costs across BOMs.

classes.name: BOMUpdateTool
classes.description: A class for managing BOM updates, including replacing BOMs, validating BOMs, and updating BOM items.

methods.name: replace_bom
methods.description: Replaces the current BOM with a new BOM, updating related BOM items and handling versioning.

methods.name: validate_bom
methods.description: Validates that the current BOM and new BOM are different and belong to the same item.

methods.name: update_new_bom
methods.description: Updates BOM item records with a new BOM number and recalculated costs.

methods.name: get_parent_boms
methods.description: Recursively retrieves parent BOMs of a given BOM, preventing recursion loops.
